name: pusht-author-preset-vs-tuning-20261029-v1
case_selection: Ascending distinct source episode order; first row divisible by 25 relative to episode start with goal at +25, pusher displacement >=100 and block displacement >=30 px, both pusher endpoints in [70,442]^2. Geometry and rendered-target admission only, never success-based selection. First six admitted cases are development; next six are evaluation. Each split covers island radius12/20, bar length60/100 radius7, gate gap100/70 with offset65. Pose-only source means zero pusher velocity in both arms, declared before outcomes.
admission: Use actual native settled start. Require both full-pusher endpoints at >=10 px hazard/arena clearance, leaving 4 px beyond the fixed 6 px safety margin. Hazard origin from midpoint by demonstrated pusher arc length, never a planner rollout. Rejected preparation attempts remain counted.
controls: Same start, goal, seed and frozen model with no added hazard; workspace constraint remains active.
selection: Development only. Require zero margin breaches/errors and no reduction in no-hazard completion relative to authors. Maximize hazard safe completions, then control safe completions, then minimize total J with every unfinished episode charged 50 actions. Prefer authors on ties.
computation: Authors: 300 candidates x30 iterations x5 model steps per 25 executed actions. Every candidate receives 1800 search predictor steps per committed action, at most90000 per50-action episode. Replan blocks restricted to1,2,5 so all divide50 actions. Candidate population=300*replan_blocks/horizon. Chosen-plan forecasts, encoders and wall time reported separately.
conditional_extension_gate: Proceed to TwoRoom, Reacher and Cube only if selected has strictly more safe completions than authors on the six reserved hazard cases, zero additional margin breaches, no lower safe completion on paired no-hazard controls, and all engineering/calibration/audit checks pass. Such extension must fit the unchanged $5 aggregate rental cap.
stopping: No case or seed replacement after outcomes; no additional optimizer trials. Preserve and diagnose engineering errors before any separately frozen repair. Existing deadline remains2026-10-30T01:27:16.558798Z unless successful gate admits a within-budget extension. Destroy pod only after verified preservation.
limitations: Small pilot with one seed per case. Public demonstration episodes are distinct within the study but may overlap world-model training; no globally untouched-task claim. Authors planning hyperparameters are retained, not a replication of the authors dataset evaluation protocol.
engineering_test_repair: First remote suite: integer-coordinate admission test exposed a dtype cast error before any trial or preparation; convert endpoint coordinates to float. Preserve failed test log and charge its native reset, then rerun suite.
